in_latin.name: Ambler
in_latin.meaning: Name originating from Middle English occupational surname, derived from Old French.
in_latin.long_meaning: Ambler, a name originating from Middle English occupational surname, is derived from Old French. The name Ambler is associated with the occupation of a person who walks or carries something, often related to the trade of a porter or a messenger. In Christian tradition, the name Ambler symbolizes the importance of physical and spiritual mobility, as well as the ability to carry one's faith with them throughout their journey.
